comparisons.reason: Different constructs and eligibility. Feature 0 counts any engagement (addressing, accepting, building on, or paraphrasing) with a cited OP example or premise from the argument text. Engagement need not be critical, and paraphrase or naming is allowed. Feature 1 requires an explicit verbatim quote of an OP title or argument phrase and a dispute of that quoted material. Paraphrase and non-disputing quotes are excluded. Their text scopes differ (argument only vs title+argument), and so do their null rules.
